info.title: ApexPost Logistics API
info.description: Shipment tracking for ApexPost couriers and partners: create and track shipments, move them through the status lifecycle Created → PickedUp → InTransit → OutForDelivery → Delivered | Failed, and upload courier scans idempotently. Every error is an RFC 7807 ProblemDetails response.

get.summary: Track a shipment as a partner
get.description: Returns the status, destination city and latest scan of one shipment, without the recipient's name, phone or address. Authenticate with a partner key in the X-Api-Key header (security scheme ApiKey).

200.description: Status, destination city and latest scan of the shipment.

401.description: The X-Api-Key header is missing or holds an unknown key.

404.description: No shipment has this tracking number, or it is not APX- followed by 8 digits.

post.description: Stores a batch of 1 to 100 courier scans. The scanId (scan::{GUID}) is the idempotency key: a scan that is already stored, or repeated in the batch, is counted once under duplicatesSkipped, so the same batch can be sent again safely. A scan of another shipment or one that would move the status backwards is listed under rejected with a reason; the valid scans are still stored.

200.description: The counts of accepted, duplicate and rejected scans.

400.description: The batch or a scan field is missing or invalid.

404.description: No shipment has this tracking number.

401.description: No valid bearer token: missing, expired or not signed with the API's key.

403.description: The token is not a Courier token, or a scan was recorded by another courier.

get.summary: Get the scans of a shipment
get.description: Returns the scan history of one shipment, oldest first by scannedAtUtc.

200.description: The scans, oldest first; empty when none were uploaded yet.

404.description: No shipment has this tracking number.

401.description: No valid bearer token: missing, expired or not signed with the API's key.

get.description: Returns one page of shipments, each with its nested recipient and latest scan, optionally only one status and one city. pageSize is 1 to 50 (default 20); a larger value is answered with 400.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Only shipments to this city, ignoring case.

200.description: One page of shipments, ordered by tracking number.

400.description: page or pageSize out of range, or an unknown status.

401.description: No valid bearer token: missing, expired or not signed with the API's key.

post.description: Registers a new shipment, which starts as Created. Answers 201 with the shipment and a Location header pointing to GET /api/v2/shipments/{trackingNumber}.

requestBody.description: The tracking number, nested recipient and weight.

201.description: The new shipment; the Location header points to it.

400.description: A field is missing or invalid.

409.description: A shipment with this tracking number already exists.

401.description: No valid bearer token: missing, expired or not signed with the API's key.

403.description: The token does not have the Admin role.

get.description: Returns one shipment by tracking number with its latest scan (null when there is none). A value that is not APX- followed by 8 digits does not match the route and is answered with 404 as well.

200.description: The shipment with its latest scan.

404.description: No shipment has this tracking number, or it is not APX- followed by 8 digits.

401.description: No valid bearer token: missing, expired or not signed with the API's key.

put.description: Replaces the recipient and weight of a shipment. The tracking number and status do not change; a Delivered or Failed shipment cannot be changed (409).

requestBody.description: The new nested recipient and weight.

400.description: A field is missing or invalid.

404.description: No shipment has this tracking number.

409.description: The shipment is Delivered or Failed, or was changed by someone else.

401.description: No valid bearer token: missing, expired or not signed with the API's key.

403.description: The token does not have the Admin role.

delete.description: Deletes a shipment that is still Created. Once a courier has picked it up the history must stay, so any later status is answered with 409.

404.description: No shipment has this tracking number.

409.description: The shipment is no longer Created.

401.description: No valid bearer token: missing, expired or not signed with the API's key.

403.description: The token does not have the Admin role.

patch.summary: Change the status of a shipment
patch.description: Moves a shipment forward: Created → PickedUp → InTransit → OutForDelivery → Delivered | Failed. A move backwards, to the same status or out of Delivered/Failed is answered with 409.

requestBody.description: The status to move to, by name.

200.description: The shipment with its new status.

400.description: The status is missing or unknown.

404.description: No shipment has this tracking number.

409.description: The move is not forward, or the shipment was changed by someone else.

401.description: No valid bearer token: missing, expired or not signed with the API's key.

403.description: The token does not have the Courier role.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number, APX- followed by 8 digits. It must not exist yet.

recipient.description: Who receives the shipment and where.

CreateShipmentRequest.description: The body of POST /api/v2/shipments: a new shipment, which starts as Created.

scanType.description: What the courier recorded: Pickup, InTransit, Delivered or Failed.

scannedAtUtc.description: When the scan happened, in UTC.

LatestScanResponse.description: The most recent scan of a shipment, in short.

items.description: The items of this page, at most .

totalCount.description: How many items match the filter on all pages.

PagedResponseOfShipmentResponse.description: One page of a list, with what a client needs to ask for the next one.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number, APX- followed by 8 digits.

status.description: The current status: Created, PickedUp, InTransit, OutForDelivery, Delivered or Failed.

latestScan.description: The most recent scan by scannedAtUtc; null when no scan was uploaded yet.

PartnerShipmentResponse.description:
What a partner sees of a shipment: status, destination city and the latest scan. The name, phone and address of
the recipient are left out, because a partner only needs to track the parcel.

phone.description: The phone number: 7 to 15 digits or spaces, optionally starting with +.

RecipientRequest.description: The recipient of a shipment in a v2 request, as one nested object.

RecipientResponse.description: The recipient of a shipment in a v2 answer.

scanId.description: The device document id of the refused scan.

examples: The scan would move the status from Delivered back to InTransit.
The scan would move the status from Delivered back to InTransit.
reason.description: Why the scan was refused, in plain words.

RejectedScanResponse.description: A scan the server refused; the device marks it Failed.

scanId.description: The device document id, scan:: followed by a GUID; it makes a repeated upload a duplicate.

oneOf.description: What the courier recorded: Pickup, InTransit, Delivered or Failed.

scanType.description: What the courier recorded: Pickup, InTransit, Delivered or Failed.

courierId.description: The courier, CR- followed by 3 digits.

scannedAtUtc.description: When the scan happened, in UTC; at most 2 minutes ahead of the server clock.

recipientSignatureName.description: Who signed for the shipment; required when  is Delivered.

ScanItem.description:
One scan in a v2 upload: the courier device document, with  by name as the device stores it.
A Delivered scan also needs ; the name is checked here and not stored.

scanId.description: The device document id, scan:: followed by a GUID.

scanType.description: What the courier recorded: Pickup, InTransit, Delivered or Failed.

courierId.description: The courier, CR- followed by 3 digits.

scannedAtUtc.description: When the scan happened, in UTC.

notes.description: Free text from the courier, if any.

receivedAtUtc.description: When the server stored the scan, in UTC.

ScanResponse.description: A stored scan of a shipment in v2, with the scan type by name.

ScanUploadRequest.description: The body of POST /api/v2/shipments/{trackingNumber}/scans: a batch of device scans, safe to send again.

accepted.description: How many scans this upload stored.

duplicatesSkipped.description: How many scans were already stored, or repeated in the batch, and were skipped.

rejected.description: The scans the server refused, each with a reason; empty when all were valid.

ScanUploadResult.description:
The answer to a scan upload: `{ accepted, duplicatesSkipped, rejected: [{ scanId, reason }] }`. Accepted and
duplicate scans become Synced on the device, rejected ones Failed.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number, APX- followed by 8 digits.

recipient.description: Who receives the shipment and where.

status.description: The current status: Created, PickedUp, InTransit, OutForDelivery, Delivered or Failed.

latestScan.description: The most recent scan by scannedAtUtc; null when no scan was uploaded yet.

createdAtUtc.description: When the shipment was registered, in UTC.

version.description: A counter that grows with every change of the shipment.

ShipmentResponse.description: A shipment in v2: a nested recipient, the latest scan and the status by name.

recipient.description: Who receives the shipment and where.

UpdateShipmentRequest.description:
The body of PUT /api/v2/shipments/{trackingNumber}: the new recipient and weight. The tracking number comes from
the route and cannot change.

oneOf.description: The new status: Created, PickedUp, InTransit, OutForDelivery, Delivered or Failed. Only forward moves pass.

status.description: The new status: Created, PickedUp, InTransit, OutForDelivery, Delivered or Failed. Only forward moves pass.

UpdateStatusRequest.description: The body of PATCH /api/v2/shipments/{trackingNumber}/status: the status to move to, by name.

ApiKey.description: A partner key, issued per partner and kept in configuration (PartnerKeys section).
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key

Bearer.description: A JWT from dotnet user-jwts or, in Development, POST /dev/token. Roles: Courier, Admin.
